### Phase 2 implementation slices (tracked)

Filed from the per-slice map in this ADR section. Each is independently revertable and gated behind "reference tz unset → UTC":

1. #1978 — reference-timezone resolver + `ExecutionContext.timezone` *(foundational; blocks 3–5)*
2. #1979 — thread context into `applyFormulaPlan` *(independent; worth doing on its own)*
3. #1980 — tz-aware `today()`/`daysFromNow()`/`daysAgo()` *(produces the shared `partsInTz` util)*
4. #1981 — render datetime in reference tz (formatters + email)
5. #1982 — tz-aware analytics date bucketing *(depends on 1 + 3)*
6. #1983 — activate report-schedule cron + timezone *(self-contained; liveness enforce)*

Cron day-boundaries (`sys_job`) need no change — already tz-wired via croner.
